summary: Learn to design, govern, and report green loans and ESG-linked lending products. Build practical tools for sustainable finance implementation.
lede: ESG-linked lending and sustainable finance product design training shows how to connect financing terms with eligible activities, credible environmental outcomes, reliable borrower data, and accountable portfolio governance. You will learn to assess ESG and climate risk, structure pricing or covenant mechanisms, validate performance data, and report outcomes to credit committees and external stakeholders. Using the Green Loan Principles, Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles, Equator Principles, and IFC Performance Standards as reference points, you will build practical product-design work products. The course includes an eligibility matrix, risk register, target-setting worksheet, KPI dashboard, product governance paper, selected financed-emissions indicators, and an implementation roadmap supported by Microsoft Excel or Microsoft Power BI.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who structure, approve, monitor, govern, or report sustainable finance products within financial institutions. It suits intermediate practitioners who understand lending or portfolio processes and need a practical ESG application layer.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to corporate lending, credit analysis, portfolio management, ESG, or financial product development. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with financial statements, credit approval processes, and basic Excel calculations will help you complete the practical exercises. Advanced topics such as PCAF financed-emissions accounting, climate scenario analysis, and IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 are taught at an operational application and commissioning level, rather than production-engineering or assurance level.
